spans.s: bhos, ij. [contraction of bhavas, V. vc. 🞄of bhavat] used in addressing persons make and 🞄female (often several), Sir! oh! ho there! hark! 🞄often repeated bho bhoḥ: in soliloquies = 🞄alas! (the final visarga is retained before 🞄hard letters only, being dropped before 🞄vowels and soft consonants).
